release_notes: REDESIGN /admin/server: the previous view was 5607 lines of corrupted duplicated HTML (the Server Configuration form was copy-pasted dozens of times, nesting endlessly). Fully rebuilt in the modern PlanetHosts style: 6 stat cards (CPU load, memory, disk, uptime, active accounts, CPU cores), a system info table (hostname / OS / kernel / CPU model / load average / memory / disk), a services table with status dots and working start/stop/restart buttons (the controller now enriches each service with its real systemd unit name so systemctl actions work), a compact server configuration card (set hostname + main domain), and quick links (full server config, tweak settings, process manager, terminal). Verified live: all stats populate (CPU 2.1, memory 19MB, disk 31GB, uptime 70d) and all 7 services render.
